title: 第九章 四守同契星芒初聚第十章 暗影执念过往碎片
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 暗沉如墨的天幕依旧笼罩着整座琉光星冕综合学园，盛夏白日里澄澈明媚的天光被层层厚重诡谲的暗紫色幻雾彻底遮蔽，温柔晚风早已被刺骨阴冷的暗影戾气取代，呼啸穿掠过整片校园的楼宇街巷。
半空之中，无边无际的堕化幻雾翻涌盘旋，无数高阶幻影魔物盘踞在学园每一处角落，漆黑狰狞的魔影遮蔽步道、盘踞楼顶、围堵廊道，冰冷的魔物嘶吼此起彼伏，震得空气阵阵震颤，细碎的黑色暗影刃气在半空肆意流窜，每一缕戾气都裹挟着侵蚀心神、禁锢灵力的诡谲力量，将往日烟火融融、温柔安然的校园，彻底化作一片肃杀冰冷的暗战绝境。
高空之上，天野凛星身姿挺拔凌立，金冰交织的圣光战衣在暗沉天幕下熠熠生辉，利落高束的鎏金渐变马尾随凛冽风势轻轻翻飞，澄澈锐利的冰蓝色眼眸扫遍全域战场，眼底凝满沉稳凛冽的战意，无半分浮躁，无半分松懈。
手中冰星宝剑寒光凛冽、星纹流转，冰系本源的极寒之力与圣光本源的净化之力在剑身疯狂交织暴涨，丝丝缕缕冰金流光顺着剑脊游走盘旋，极致凌厉的杀伐气场与统领全局的王者气场全然绽放。
方才全域爆发的暗影动乱覆盖极广，高阶幻影魔物数量繁多、分布零散，又自带幻术潜行与心神侵蚀的特殊能力，远比此前任何一波暗影入侵更加难缠。
紫苑梦绪刻意收敛的攻势看似没有掀起毁灭性灾难，却精准拿捏了消耗拉扯的战术核心，以海量魔物分散袭扰、全域牵制，逼迫守护者全员持续输出灵力、长久紧绷心神，一点点磨损光明战力的储备，耐心探查战队全员的战斗短板与联动破绽。
隐匿在高空暗幻领域深处的她，始终静默俯瞰全局，以顶尖幻术视野记录着每一位守护者的战斗节奏、技能冷却、攻防习惯与配合细节，眼底明暗交织的挣扎从未停歇，心底黑暗宿命与人间温暖的博弈依旧汹涌拉扯。
而身处战局之中的四位守护者，无人察觉暗处影侍的隐忍与迟疑，全员心神紧绷，专注应对眼前连绵不绝的暗影攻势，默契衔接、各司其职，以最稳固的攻防闭环，稳步肃清全域暗影魔物。
天野凛星声线沉稳铿锵，穿透呼啸阴风与魔物嘶吼，清晰传入其余三人耳中，条理分明的战术指令精准统筹全场战局，尽显队长的沉稳格局与统筹能力。
“所有高阶幻影魔物具备幻术隐匿、心神侵蚀、分体潜行三重特性，不可仅凭蛮力肃清。”
“焰织，持续铺展红莲火网与草木禁锢结界，彻底封锁暗幻雾气的再生渠道，断绝魔物幻术加持的力量根基，优先清除全域残留暗力。”
“涟音、金朵，维持双层防御治愈结界不中断，细化结界防护层级，重点护住教学楼内未及时撤离的滞留师生，同时以双生同源灵力中和空气内的侵蚀戾气，安抚全员心神损耗。”
“我正面突进战场核心，定点斩杀高阶魔物主力，分割敌方阵型，逐一清剿残敌！”
简洁利落的指令落定，四人经年磨合、生死并肩的绝佳默契无需多余言语，瞬息之间同步发力、全员开战。
战场高空侧方，藤咲若织凌立暗雾之间，绯霞绛红渐变的战衣身姿温婉却凌厉，哑光绯纹面具稳稳覆于眉眼之上，繁复草木焰纹暗纹在暗沉天光下流转细碎红光，彻底隐匿她的真实容貌，只余下一双清冷澄澈、凝光如焰的眼眸，静静俯瞰下方纷乱战局。
自始至终，她的草木灵力与红莲净火从未有半分停歇。
听闻天野凛星的战术指令，她清冷颔首，柔顺垂落的红焰渐变长卷发随灵力涌动轻轻翻飞，周身翠绿色草木本源灵力与绯红色红莲烈焰本源瞬间同步暴涨，两股截然相融的力量缠绕周身、冲天而起，瞬间冲破层层暗雾桎梏。
草木之力蓬勃舒展、蔓延全域，带着生生不息的净化禁锢之力，化作万千纤细坚韧的翠绿藤蔓，自虚空破土而生、肆意疯长，以肉眼可见的速度铺满整片学园空域。
无数藤蔓纵横交错、层层交织，枝干坚硬如钢、纹路熠熠生辉，细密的枝叶之间萦绕红莲星火，密密麻麻构筑成一张覆盖整座校园的巨型禁锢结界，牢牢锁死所有魔物的潜行路径与逃窜空间，让所有隐匿在暗雾之中的幻影魔物尽数暴露身形，无处遁形。
紧随其后，燎原般的红莲净火顺着藤蔓脉络疯狂蔓延燃烧，绯红烈焰灼灼盛放、遇暗即焚、逢邪即灭，带着最纯粹的净化之力，精准克制堕化幻力的暗黑本源。
“圣草焰硝繁焰！”
藤咲若织轻启唇齿，温婉却坚定的灵力吟唱响彻长空，红绿交织的灵力箭雨自翠草焚焰弓矢之上破空而出，万千焰光箭矢密集如雨、精准落向学园各个角落。
每一道箭矢落地，便炸开一片炽热纯粹的红莲火域，暗紫色的堕化幻雾触碰烈焰的瞬间，即刻滋滋消融、化为虚无，空气中萦绕的侵蚀戾气被层层净化、彻底消散。
原本不断滋生、流转、侵蚀全域的暗幻气场，在草木结界的封锁与红莲净火的灼烧之下，快速萎缩消退、日渐稀薄，魔物赖以生存的幻术环境被彻底破除，所有潜行、隐身、幻境加持的优势荡然无存。
她的操控精准到极致，力道收放自如、分寸拿捏得当，大范围清场的同时绝不伤及分毫建筑，更不会波及结界内的无辜师生，每一缕灵力、每一道箭雨，都只为肃清黑暗、守护安宁，温柔且强大，隐忍且可靠。
她始终静默立于战场侧方，不抢锋芒、不求出彩，以自身最强的远程禁锢与净化能力，为全队兜底护场，默默稳住整场战局的根基，为正面作战的天野凛星扫清一切环境阻碍，为双生守护者的治愈防御减轻所有外界压力。
这份不动声色的周全守护，藏在面具之下的隐忍强大，无人窥见全部，却实实在在撑起了整场暗战最稳固的后方防线。
地面全域结界之内，海月涟音与琉璃金朵并肩而立，两道同源共生的光明灵力冲天而起，碧岚水风圣光与粉金岩土圣辉交相辉映、相融共生，温柔坚韧的守护之力层层铺开，稳稳护住整片学园的所有人居区域。
身着苍绿清碧渐变战衣的海月涟音，眉眼温柔坚定，澄澈如水的眼眸盛满纯粹的守护信念，水风双生本源灵力平稳流转周身，没有半分紊乱耗竭。
她抬手轻握掌心悬浮的天籁海螺，温润轻灵的灵力顺着海螺纹路缓缓灌注，温柔清澈的吟唱随风响起，治愈与防御的力量层层蔓延。
“水风清岚御盾！”
澄澈碧绿的水风灵力瞬间铺展、层层叠加，巨型柔性水风结界再度扩容、加固延展，柔韧绵长的水风屏障细密无隙、自愈不休，如同温柔的碧波江海笼罩整片楼宇。
所有撞击结界的暗影刃气、魔物戾气，尽数被水风之力温柔卸去、层层消解，不会产生半分冲击震动，不会惊扰结界内惶恐不安的师生。同时清岚之风裹挟纯净治愈灵力，丝丝缕缕渗入空气，抚平所有人心底残留的恐慌躁动，修复众人被暗力侵蚀的心神损耗，让结界之内始终维持安稳温润的光明气场。
身侧的琉璃金朵同步蓄力，粉樱渐变的战裙随灵力流转轻轻晃动，娇俏灵动的眼眸盛满并肩作战的坚定，掌心柔情丝线灵光熠熠，土金本源的厚重力量全然苏醒、蓬勃绽放。
她清甜利落的唱名紧随响起，厚重稳固的岩土灵力冲天铺展，与水风结界完美契合、双层叠加。
“土金鎏壤御壁！”
厚重坚硬的鎏金岩土壁垒扎根大地、扶摇而上，坚硬无双的金石屏障细密规整、固若金汤，完美补强水风结界的防御破绽，刚柔并济、攻守兼备。
岩土之力稳固八方、镇压暗邪，金石纹路熠熠生辉，为整个防御结界加持无尽抗性，彻底隔绝外界所有暗黑伤害。与此同时，细碎的鎏金灵力丝线四散纷飞、融入队友周身，为天野凛星、藤咲若织、海月涟音三人持续叠加攻防增益，小幅强化所有人的灵力输出与防御抗性，细致补足团战的每一处细微短板。
双生少女并肩而立、同心同力，水风治愈控场、土金固防增益，同源灵力共振不息、完美互补，构筑起整场战局最温柔也最坚固的守护屏障，牢牢护住身后整片人间安宁。
正面战场核心区域，天野凛星已然开启极致瞬身突袭，化作一道冰金交织的流光，在密密麻麻的高阶魔物阵型之中肆意穿梭、辗转腾挪。
content_en:
The dark sky still shrouds the entire Glazed Star Comprehensive Academy. The clear and bright skylight in the midsummer day is completely obscured by layers of thick and strange dark purple phantom fog. The gentle evening breeze has long been replaced by the biting and cold shadows and ruthless air, whistling through the buildings and streets of the entire campus.
In mid-air, the boundless corrupted phantom mist surged and swirled. Countless high-level phantom monsters were entrenched in every corner of the academy. The dark and ferocious shadows covered the walkways, occupied the rooftops, and blocked the corridors. The cold monsters roared one after another, shaking the air. There was a tremor, and the fine black shadow blade energy flowed freely in the air. Every ray of vicious energy was wrapped with the strange power that corroded the mind and imprisoned the spiritual power, turning the peaceful and gentle campus of the past into a chilling and cold desperate situation.
High in the sky, Amano Rinxing stood tall and tall, his holy light battle suit intertwined with gold and ice shone brightly under the dark sky, and his neat and high-bundled gilt gradient horse tail flew gently in the cold wind. His clear and sharp ice-blue eyes scanned the entire battlefield, and his eyes were filled with a calm and cold fighting spirit, without any impetuousness or relaxation.
The Ice Star Sword in his hand has a cold light and flowing star patterns. The extreme cold power of the ice source and the purifying power of the holy light are wildly intertwined on the sword body. Wisps of ice gold flowing light travel along the spine of the sword, and the extremely fierce killing aura and the kingly aura that dominates the overall situation are fully bloomed.
The shadow turmoil that just broke out across the entire territory covers a wide area. High-level phantom monsters are numerous and scattered. They also have special abilities of illusion stealth and mind erosion. They are far more difficult to deal with than any previous wave of shadow invasion.
Shion Mengxu's deliberately restrained offensive did not seem to cause a devastating disaster, but he accurately grasped the core of the strategy of consumption and pulling. He used massive monsters to disperse and harass and contain the whole area, forcing all the guardians to continuously output spiritual power, tense their minds for a long time, gradually wearing down the reserve of bright combat power, and patiently exploring the combat shortcomings and linkage flaws of all team members.
Hidden in the depths of the high-altitude dark fantasy realm, she always silently overlooks the overall situation, recording each guardian's combat rhythm, skill cooldown, offensive and defensive habits, and coordination details with top illusion vision. The struggle between light and dark in her eyes never stops, and the game of dark fate and human warmth in her heart is still turbulent.
As for the four guardians caught in the middle of the battle, no one noticed the forbearance and hesitation of the shadow warriors in the shadows. All of them were tense and focused on dealing with the continuous shadow offensive in front of them. They worked in tacit coordination and performed their duties. With the most stable offensive and defensive closed loop, they steadily eliminated the shadow monsters in the entire area.
Amano Rinxei's calm and sonorous voice penetrated the howling wind and the roar of monsters, and was clearly transmitted to the ears of the other three people. His well-organized tactical instructions accurately coordinated the entire battle situation, fully demonstrating the captain's calm pattern and coordination ability.
"All high-level phantom monsters have the three characteristics of illusion concealment, mind erosion, and split stealth. They cannot be eliminated with brute force alone."
"Fireweaver, continue to spread the red lotus fire net and the grass and tree confinement barrier, completely block the regeneration channels of the dark mist, cut off the power foundation of the magic of monsters, and prioritize the removal of the remaining dark forces in the entire area."
"Lianyin and Jinduo, maintain the double-layered defense and healing barrier without interruption, refine the barrier protection levels, and focus on protecting the teachers and students who are stranded in the teaching building who have not been evacuated in time. At the same time, use the spiritual power of twins to neutralize the corrosive and hostile atmosphere in the air, so as to appease the mental loss of all members."
"I rush into the core of the battlefield head-on, kill the main force of high-level monsters at fixed points, divide the enemy's formation, and eliminate the remaining enemies one by one!"
The concise and concise instructions were finalized, and the excellent tacit understanding of the four people who had worked together for many years and worked side by side in life and death did not require any unnecessary words. In an instant, all members started to fight simultaneously.
On the high side of the battlefield, Fujisaki Wakaori stands tall in the dark mist, with a gentle but fierce figure in a crimson-red battle suit. The matte scarlet mask is firmly covering her eyebrows and eyes. The complex flame patterns of vegetation and dark patterns flow into tiny red light under the dim sky, completely hiding her true appearance. Only a pair of cold, clear eyes with condensed light like flames are left, quietly overlooking the chaos of the battle below.
From beginning to end, her spiritual power of plants and trees and the pure fire of red lotus never stopped for a moment.
After hearing Amano Rinsei's tactical instructions, she nodded coldly, and her long curly hair that gradually fell into red flames flew gently with the surge of spiritual power. The original spiritual power of the emerald green vegetation and the crimson red lotus flames all around her suddenly surged simultaneously. The two completely integrated forces wrapped around her body and soared into the sky, instantly breaking through the shackles of the dark fog.
The power of vegetation flourished and spread throughout the entire area. With the endless power of purification and imprisonment, it turned into thousands of slender and tough green vines, sprouting from the void and growing wildly, covering the entire airspace of the academy at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Countless vines are criss-crossing and intertwined in layers. The branches are as hard as steel and the lines are shining. The red lotus sparks are lingering between the fine branches and leaves. They are densely packed to form a giant confinement barrier that covers the entire campus. It firmly blocks the sneak paths and escape spaces of all monsters, allowing all phantom monsters hidden in the dark mist to expose their bodies and have nowhere to escape.
Immediately afterwards, the red lotus pure fire like a prairie fire spread and burned crazily along the veins of the vines. The crimson flames bloomed, burning in the face of darkness and destroyed in the face of evil. With the purest power of purification, it accurately restrained the dark origin of the corrupted illusion.
"The holy grass is in flames!"
Fujisaki Wakaori lightly opened her lips and teeth, and her gentle but firm spiritual chant resounded through the sky. A rain of red and green spiritual energy arrows shot out of the sky from the green grass burning flame bow. Thousands of flaming arrows were densely packed like rain, falling accurately to every corner of the school.
Every time an arrow hits the ground, a field of blazing and pure red lotus fire explodes. The moment the dark purple phantom fog touches the flames, it instantly melts and turns into nothingness. The corrosive and vicious energy lingering in the air is purified layer by layer and completely dissipated.
The dark phantom aura that was constantly growing, flowing, and eroding the entire area quickly shrank and became thinner under the blockage of the vegetation barrier and the burning of the red lotus pure fire. The illusion environment that the monsters relied on for survival was completely eliminated, and all the advantages of stealth, invisibility, and illusion blessing were gone.
Her control is extremely precise, her strength can be freely expanded and measured, and she can clear a large area without damaging any buildings, let alone the innocent teachers and students in the barrier. Every ray of spiritual power and every arrow rain is only to clear the darkness and protect peace. She is gentle and powerful, tolerant and reliable.
She always stood silently on the side of the battlefield, not seeking the edge or being outstanding. She used her strongest long-range confinement and purification abilities to protect the entire team, silently stabilizing the foundation of the entire battle, clearing all environmental obstacles for Amano Rinsei who was fighting head-on, and alleviating all external pressure for the healing defense of the Twin Guardians.
This calm and thorough protection, the forbearance hidden under the mask is powerful, no one can see it all, but it really supports the most stable rear defense line in the entire secret war.
Within the global barrier on the ground, the Sea Moon Lianyin and the Glazed Golden Flower stand side by side. Two sources of light and spiritual power rise from the same source and coexist in the sky. The holy light of azure water and wind and the holy light of pink gold rock and earth complement each other and coexist. The gentle and tough protective power spreads out layer by layer, stably protecting all the residential areas of the entire academy.
Haiyue Lianyin, who is wearing a green and clear blue gradation battle dress, has gentle and firm eyebrows, and her clear water eyes are full of pure faith in guardianship. The spiritual power of the twins of water and wind flows smoothly around her without any confusion or exhaustion.
She raised her hand and gently grasped the natural conch floating in her palm. The warm and light spiritual power slowly poured in along the lines of the conch. The gentle and clear chanting sounded in the wind, and the power of healing and defense spread layer by layer.
"Shui Feng Qing Lan Royal Shield!"
The clear green water and wind spiritual power instantly spread and overlapped layer by layer. The giant flexible water and wind barrier expanded, strengthened and extended again. The flexible and long water and wind barrier was fine and seamless and healed endlessly, just like the gentle blue waves of the river and sea covering the entire building.
All the shadow blade energy and monster's hostile energy that hit the barrier were gently removed and dissolved layer by layer by the power of water and wind. There would not be any impact or vibration, and it would not disturb the frightened teachers and students in the barrier. At the same time, the clear wind envelops pure healing spiritual power, seeping into the air, calming the remaining panic and agitation in everyone's hearts, repairing the mental loss of everyone who has been eroded by the dark force, and maintaining a stable and warm light aura within the barrier.
The glazed golden flowers beside her are simultaneously accumulating power, the pink-red war skirt is gently swaying with the flow of spiritual power, the delicate and smart eyes are full of determination to fight side by side, the tender silk threads in the palms are shining, and the heavy power of the earth and metal is fully awakened and blooming.
Her sweet and crisp roll call sounded immediately, and the thick and stable spiritual power of rock and earth spread to the sky, perfectly matching the water and wind barrier and superimposing it in two layers.
"The earth is gold and the wall is gilded with gold!"
The thick and hard gilded rock and earth barrier is rooted in the earth and rises upward. The unparalleled hard gold and stone barrier is fine, regular and solid. It perfectly strengthens the defensive flaws of the water and wind barrier. It is both hard and soft, capable of both offense and defense.
The power of rock and earth stabilizes all directions and suppresses dark evil. The golden and stone patterns shine brightly, adding endless resistance to the entire defensive barrier and completely blocking out all dark damage from the outside world. At the same time, the fine gilt spiritual power threads scattered around and integrated into the teammates, continuously superimposing offensive and defensive gains for Amano Rinsei, Fujisaki Wakaori, and Kaige Renone, slightly strengthening everyone's spiritual power output and defensive resistance, and meticulously making up for every subtle shortcoming in the team battle.
The twin girls stand side by side and work together, water and wind heal and control the field, earth and metal strengthen the defense, and the spiritual power of the same source resonates endlessly and complements each other perfectly, building the gentlest and strongest protective barrier in the entire battle, firmly protecting the peace of the entire world behind them.
In the core area of ​​​​the frontal battlefield, Amano Rinxei has launched the ultimate instantaneous attack, turning into a stream of ice and gold, moving freely through the dense formation of high-level monsters.
title_en: Chapter 9: The stars of the Four Guards gather together for the first time Chapter 10: Fragments of the past of Shadow Obsession
